units.source_text: 这一天源氏又去访问东院的花散里，对她说道：“今天近卫府官员在马场练习骑射，

en.t: That day Genji again visited Hanachirusato in the eastern wing and said to her, "Today the officers of the Guards are practicing horseback archery at the riding ground,

units.source_text: 夕雾中将欲乘便带几个男子来此访问。

en.t: and Lieutenant General Yugiri intends to take the opportunity to bring several young men here for a visit.

units.source_text: 你须早做准备。

en.t: You should make your preparations early.

units.source_text: 白昼里就要来的。

en.t: They are expected to come during the day.

units.source_text: 真奇怪，这里的事情虽然静悄悄地绝不铺张，

en.t: It is very strange: although everything here is kept quiet and never made showy,

units.source_text: 这些亲王们也会知道，都来访问，事情自然闹大了。

en.t: these princes will hear of it too, and if they all come visiting, the affair will naturally become a great stir.

units.source_text: 你要留意才是。”

en.t: You must be careful about it."

units.source_text: 马场殿离此不远，从廊上可以望见。

en.t: The riding-ground hall was not far from here and could be seen from the gallery.

units.source_text: 源氏对侍女们说：“姑娘们啊，把廊房的门户打开，

en.t: Genji said to the waiting women, "Ladies, open the doors of the gallery rooms,

units.source_text: 大家在这里观赏骑射竞赛吧。

en.t: and let us all watch the horseback archery contest from here.

units.source_text: 今天左近卫府许多漂亮的官员要来，

en.t: Many handsome officers of the Left Guards will come today,

units.source_text: 相貌并不比寻寻常常的殿上人差呢。”

en.t: and in looks they are no worse than ordinary courtiers of the palace."

units.source_text: 众青年侍女便兴致勃勃地等候着。

en.t: The young waiting women all waited with eager interest.

units.source_text: 玉鬘那里也有女童们来此观赏。

en.t: Some girl attendants from Tamakazura's quarters also came here to watch.

units.source_text: 廊房门口挂起绿油油的帘子，

en.t: Glossy green blinds were hung at the entrance to the gallery rooms,

units.source_text: 又设了许多新式的染成上淡下浓颜色的帷屏。

en.t: and many new-style curtain screens dyed pale above and deep below were set up.

units.source_text: 女童和女仆们憧憧往来不绝。

en.t: Girl attendants and maidservants kept coming and going without cease.

units.source_text: 身穿蓝面深红里子的衫子，外罩紫红色薄绸汗袗的女童，

en.t: The girl attendants wearing robes with blue outer cloth and deep crimson lining, with thin purplish-red silk over-robes on top,

units.source_text: 大概是玉鬘那里的人吧，共有四人，样子都很聪明伶俐。

en.t: were probably from Tamakazura's household; there were four of them, and they all looked clever and lively.

units.source_text: 女仆们身穿上淡下浓的紫色面淡紫里的夏衣，

en.t: The maidservants wore summer robes with purple outer cloth shaded pale above and deep below and pale purple lining,

units.source_text: 和暗红面蓝里的中国服，都是端午节的打扮。

en.t: as well as Chinese-style garments with dark red outer cloth and blue lining; all were attire for the Boys' Festival.

units.source_text: 花散里这边的侍女，都穿深红色夹衫，

en.t: The waiting women on Hanachirusato's side all wore deep crimson lined jackets,

units.source_text: 上罩红面蓝里的汗袗，态度都很稳重。

en.t: with over-robes of red outer cloth and blue lining, and they all had a composed manner.

units.source_text: 各人竞夸新装，样子煞是好看。

en.t: Each showed off her new attire in rivalry, and the sight was exceedingly lovely.

units.source_text: 那些年轻的殿上人都对她们注目。

en.t: All the young courtiers fixed their attention on them.
